# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: a mount, sweep, fire and dismount of a misc_mg42.
# map mp_carentan, gametype probe_turret
# turret 298 origin=1712.0,1830.0,8.0 angles=0.0,229.0,0.0
# gunner team=allies weapon=m1carbine_mp
# Three shells, the gsc probe first:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PROBE_SECS=<past both clients> \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --probe-team axis --probe-secs 180
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --save-turret --probe-secs 170
# This one (2026-10-18, port 32952, PROBE_SECS 215, the clients' --probe-secs 190 and
# 180, --capture-tag, renamed to -full) is the first whose !trace lines carry exact=
# and velocity=, the origin and velocity at full precision.
# The gsc probe puts the gunner 40 units behind the gun facing along it and the axis
# client 300 units in front facing back.
# Phases: aim 500 ms at the gun; mount taps use; yaw sweeps -90..90 and pitch -60..60 off
# the gun, 2 degrees a cmd, each at least 4000 ms; flick turns 60 in one cmd for 500 ms; fire
# holds attack 1000 ms at the gun's yaw +30, 10 down, off the target's line; target holds it
# 1000 ms at the axis client; cool waits for the
# cooldown alias or 1500 ms; dismount taps use; crouch holds crouch and taps use 500 ms in;
# uncrouch taps use; strafe holds right until the bearing off the gun's back passes 50
# degrees inside 100 units (1500 ms at most); refused faces the gun and taps use 500 ms in.
# refused bearing= and dist= are measured on the first snapshot at or past the refused tap.
# !station is where the phase started; one per phase.
# !cmd view= is the absolute view asked for (wire shorts, before delta_angles); angles= went on the wire.
# !trace is the gunner's playerstate per snapshot; hint is serverCursorHint:Val:String.
# !turret is the gun's entity, on every snapshot where one of its fields moved.
# !event is every drained event; entity 4294967295 is this client's own playerstate ring.
# !impact is every EV_BULLET_HIT_SMALL/LARGE temp entity with its origin.
# !victim is every other player's entity on each fire and target snapshot.
# !server is every server command, tokens joined, control bytes as \xNN.
# BROKEN strafe passed 100 units at bearing 51.5 before leaving the arc
# refused bearing=57.2 dist=129.4
# BROKEN refused tap at dist=129.4
# REFUSED ok
[phase wait]
